name: synthetic-poll-error
description: Synthetic (no SURF key held at port time, 2026-09-16): the `{ data: { job_id, status, ... } }` job envelope, the status vocabulary (queued / running / succeeded / failed / canceled) and the results read follow the v1 adaptor's onchain-sql lifecycle and its 2026-08-04 probes; field values are placeholders. Unverified against live traffic — replace via `deno task record`. The poll itself answers non-2xx (the 24h retention lapsed, or the job is unknown): terminal error-as-data, zero usage — the job can no longer be observed and polls are free (design D3).

body.sql: SELECT block_date, sum(amount_usd) AS volume FROM agent.ethereum_dex_trades WHERE block_date >= toDate('2026-09-01') GROUP BY block_date ORDER BY block_date
